name: analytics_batch
sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_batch (
        attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        received_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, sent_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, client_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        accepted INTEGER NOT NULL, duplicated INTEGER NOT NULL, rejected INTEGER NOT NULL,
        http_status INTEGER NOT NULL, processing_ms INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: analytics_day
sql: CREATE TABLE analytics_day (dimension TEXT NOT NULL,day TEXT NOT NULL,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(dimension,day))

name: analytics_device_day
sql: CREATE TABLE analytics_device_day (dimension TEXT NOT NULL,day TEXT NOT NULL,device_key TEXT NOT NULL,event_count INTEGER NOT NULL,session_count INTEGER NOT NULL,last_received_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(dimension,day,device_key))

name: analytics_diagnostic_usage
sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_diagnostic_usage (
   request_id TEXT NOT NULL,device_key TEXT NOT NULL,accepted INTEGER NOT NULL,
   PRIMARY KEY(request_id,device_key))

name: analytics_dirty_day
sql: CREATE TABLE analytics_dirty_day (dimension TEXT NOT NULL, day TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(dimension,day))

name: analytics_event
sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_event (
        device_key TEXT NOT NULL, client_event_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        occurred_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, received_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, priority TEXT NOT NULL, context_json TEXT NOT NULL, properties_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        batch_attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_day TEXT, received_day TEXT NOT NULL, clock_suspicious INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(device_key,client_event_id))

name: analytics_event_seen
sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_event_seen (
        device_key TEXT NOT NULL, id_digest TEXT NOT NULL, event_hash TEXT NOT NULL, first_received_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(device_key,id_digest))

name: analytics_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE analytics_meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

name: analytics_rollup_fact
sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_rollup_fact (
 dimension TEXT NOT NULL,day TEXT NOT NULL,device_key TEXT NOT NULL,id_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 event_name TEXT NOT NULL,session_digest TEXT NOT NULL,clock_suspicious INTEGER NOT NULL,semantic_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 received_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(dimension,day,device_key,received_at_ms,id_digest))

name: analytics_rollup_retry
sql: CREATE TABLE analytics_rollup_retry (dimension TEXT NOT NULL,day TEXT NOT NULL,last_attempt_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(dimension,day))

name: analytics_settlement
sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_settlement (
        attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL, id_digest TEXT NOT NULL, outcome TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY(attempt_id,id_digest))

name: analytics_tier_day
sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_tier_day (
   day TEXT NOT NULL,device_key TEXT NOT NULL,tier TEXT NOT NULL,source_event_name TEXT NOT NULL,
   records INTEGER NOT NULL,source_events INTEGER NOT NULL,payload_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
   PRIMARY KEY(day,device_key,tier,source_event_name))

name: analytics_tier_event
sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_tier_event (
   device_key TEXT NOT NULL,client_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,event_name TEXT NOT NULL,
   occurred_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,received_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
   sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,priority TEXT NOT NULL,context_json TEXT NOT NULL,properties_json TEXT NOT NULL,
   batch_attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,occurred_day TEXT,received_day TEXT NOT NULL,clock_suspicious INTEGER NOT NULL,
   tier TEXT NOT NULL,source_event_name TEXT NOT NULL,source_event_count INTEGER NOT NULL,diagnostic_request_id TEXT,
   PRIMARY KEY(device_key,client_event_id))

name: analytics_transport
sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_transport (
    attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,encoding TEXT NOT NULL,wire_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,inflated_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: analytics_transport_day
sql:
CREATE TABLE analytics_transport_day (
    day TEXT NOT NULL,device_key TEXT NOT NULL,encoding TEXT NOT NULL,requests INTEGER NOT NULL,
    wire_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,inflated_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(day,device_key,encoding))

name: analytics_ark_device_event_received
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_ark_device_event_received ON analytics_event(device_key,event_name,received_at_ms DESC,occurred_at_ms DESC)

name: analytics_ark_device_received
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_ark_device_received ON analytics_event(device_key,received_at_ms DESC,occurred_at_ms DESC)

name: analytics_batch_received
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_batch_received ON analytics_batch(received_at_ms)

name: analytics_batch_request
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_batch_request ON analytics_batch(request_id,received_at_ms)

name: analytics_event_client_received
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_event_client_received ON analytics_event(client_event_id,received_at_ms)

name: analytics_event_days
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_event_days ON analytics_event(occurred_day,received_day)

name: analytics_event_received
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_event_received ON analytics_event(received_at_ms)

name: analytics_settlement_id
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_settlement_id ON analytics_settlement(id_digest)

name: analytics_tier_device_received
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_tier_device_received ON analytics_tier_event(device_key,received_at_ms)

name: analytics_tier_expiry
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_tier_expiry ON analytics_tier_event(tier,received_at_ms)

name: analytics_tier_id_received
sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_tier_id_received ON analytics_tier_event(client_event_id,received_at_ms)
